name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source identity and access management server with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP and SCIM, backed by MySQL.

alerts.message: Sign in with organization built-in, username admin and the password from the CASDOOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable. It only applies when the database is first created, so change the password in the admin console afterwards.
